Average ILSS for SMC-V1 made glass-SMC 78 Mechanical testing on SMC-V2 for TCF-SMC and Glass-SMC A limited amount of TCF from Kaltex precursor was used to produce ½” chopped fiber in the SMC-V2 set up. Uniform fiber lengths were evidenced as explained before. The plates were compression molded at temperature- 145°C and 926 psi (6.4 MPa) pressure with a dwell time of 3 minutes. These were subjected to a range of mechanical testing based on ASTM standards. Flexure test: ASTM D790; ILSS test: ASTM D2344; Tension test: ASTM D3039 and Izod impact test: ASTM D256. The SMC material, placement in tool, compression molding, coupon mapping, coupons and typical test frame is shown in Figure 98. Figure 98. The weight fraction is 30 wt% and the glass is the OC glass used in the trials, the carbon SMC is the the wide tow Kaltex precursor based SMC. Arotran resin has been used for purposes of this study.
